featured_reviews.name: Avinash Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently took delivery of my new Maruti XL6 from Fortpoint, and the entire experience was absolutely wonderful! From the very first visit to the final delivery day, the team made everything feel seamless and special.
​The staff was extremely professional, transparent with the documentation, and kept me updated throughout the waiting period. On the day of delivery, the car was kept ready, polished, and the ceremony was handled with great warmth. A big thank you to the entire team at Fortpoint for making this such a memorable experience for my family. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a hassle-free car buying journey!"

featured_reviews.review_text:

Thank you, Megha, and the entire team for making our XL6 delivery a memorable experience!
